result.topic_en: A struck-out derivation of a second-order linear differential equation with three singular points a, b, c and exponents μ, ν, ρ, noted to reduce to the hypergeometric differential equation when a, b, c are set to 0, ∞, 1.

methods.what: Relations between the coefficients and the exponents at the singular point a
Second-order linear ODE with three regular singular points a, b, c and exponent pairs (μ1, μ2), (ν1, ν2), (ρ1, ρ2), using δ = (b-c)(c-a)(a-b)
Specialisation to the hypergeometric equation by sending the singular points to 0, ∞, 1
